confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not inspected live prices. Argentina's prices move quickly with inflation and exchange-rate changes, so every USD anchor is uncertain, and the July 2026 window adds further uncertainty. Restaurant and hostel anchors are somewhat more reliable than hotel and cocktail anchors. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value was taken from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rate page for 15 October 2026 (AUD/USD 0.6955). I did not open the RBA page directly, so the FX figure should be checked against rba.gov.au before it is used for anything that needs an exact value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Argentine wine and tourism cities (such as Córdoba and Salta) combined with general knowledge of Mendoza's wine-region tourism pricing. No specific comparable listings were checked.
